title: Ripperdoc claim manifest (.ripperdoc/claims/<slug>.json), written by the producer when it believes the work is done

slug.description: Short kebab-case name, the same across rounds; must equal the file name

claim.description: The result as the producer states it, with its key numbers

artifacts.description: Files or folders (relative to the project root) that back the claim: code, outputs, logs, write-up. Their fingerprints tie a review to this exact version.

notes.description: Anything else the reviewer should know. Treated as the producer's claim, not as evidence.
